images.caption:
This small Shiva temple (a yoni was found inside) is located along a path that leads south from the Arjuna group. Its north face is seen here, with a central niche that is framed by the remains of a
kala-makara arch. The wall, behind the temple, is a recent construction (2007/2008).
images.alt:
This small Shiva temple (a yoni was found inside) is located along a path that leads south from the Arjuna group. Its north face is seen here, with a central niche that is framed by the remains of a
kala-makara arch. The wall, behind the temple, is a recent construction (2007/2008).

images.caption: This statue of Shiva in three-headed form can be compared to the great Sadashiva at Elephanta; the basic form is the same, although the expressions of the three faces seem less differentiated here, and both of the side heads appear to be contemplating a lotus (flower on the viewer's left, bud on the right). At elephanta, the fierce head contemplates a cobra.
images.alt: This statue of Shiva in three-headed form can be compared to the great Sadashiva at Elephanta; the basic form is the same, although the expressions of the three faces seem less differentiated here, and both of the side heads appear to be contemplating a lotus (flower on the viewer's left, bud on the right). At elephanta, the fierce head contemplates a cobra.

images.filename: Gunung Prau, Dieng, Wonosobo, Jawa Tengah, 04072015.jpg
images.caption:
Gunung prau terletak di tiga kabupaten yaitu kabupaten Wonosobo, kabupaten Kendal, kabupaten Batang. Memiliki ketinggian 2.565 mdpl.
Kenapa disebut prau, karena bentuk gunung ini yang memanjang seperti perahu. Gunung prau memiliki pemandangan yang indah dan sunrise terbaik yang muncul sekitar bulan desember-januari.
images.alt:

images.caption: Gunung Prau merupakan bentang alam yang berada di 3 kabupaten yaitu Batang, Kendal, dan Wonosobo. Gunung ini menyajikan golden sunrise yang sangat eksotis di kalangan pendaki.
